name: AskLayout
description:
The body of an ask: an AiCard (icon tile in the ask's tone, the question as the title,
controls, footer with the primary on the right). Asks are never modal (R13.8): in a
conversation the card sits in the ask dock above the composer; on its own it sits where
it is rendered.
signature: ({ id, icon, tone, title, meta, footer, footerStart, children, className, confirming, onKeyDown, }: AskLayoutProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: confirming
props.description: The second step of a destructive or MFA approval is showing (Esc goes back).

props.name: footer
props.description: Content after the body, normally supporting actions.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon element without an explicit size; the component sizes it through its tokens.

props.name: meta
props.description: Data line under the question: the target, the expiry.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Key handler on the card root, called for keys pressed anywhere inside it; approvals and confirmations use it for Esc to go back.

props.name: tone
props.description: The semantic tone. Use danger and warning for consequences and states.
